note: empty-marker shortcut returned substring(str, 0, maxWidth), ignoring offset, and a null marker skipped abbreviation; fix removes the shortcut and normalises null to empty, rewriting degenerate-marker handling rather than extending it
trailing-delimiter check also dropped a quoted empty last field as if a trailing delimiter had produced it; existing condition gained && !reusableToken.isQuoted
lastIndexOf on double and float arrays never matched NaN because NaN == NaN is false; float loop condition gained a NaN clause, double overloads a NaN guard and helper; one fault across overloads
Japanese-imperial ParseException message dropped the base message: format string lacked a %s for msg and arguments were in the wrong order; fix corrects the literal and argument order

hex branch had no case for an l/L suffix, so createInteger or createLong received it and threw; suffix handling added; removed lines: a moved lastChar and a de-finalised hexDigits adjusted under a new guard
median used a TreeSet, which drops elements the comparator deems equal, so duplicates skewed the middle element; fix sorts a cloned array instead, replacing the approach in both overloads

DATE parsed Date.toString() output with a default-locale SimpleDateFormat, failing under non-English locales; the original call survives inside a new try/catch whose catch adds a Locale.ENGLISH fallback

declaring-class walk did not stop at an anonymous or local enclosure, losing its context or yielding an empty segment; loop condition gained the anonymous/local clauses, subsuming the old top-level special case

property values were written into the Option registered in Options before handleOption cloned it, so later parses saw stale values; value now goes to the CommandLine's copy after handleOption: ownership and ordering
constant JDK_XML_ENTITY_REPLACEMENT_LIMIT held the misspelt name jdk.xml.entityReplacementLimi_t, so it never matched the real system property; wrong literal value

hashCode of the generic-array and parameterized type implementations used ad hoc shift/or formulas unequal to the JDK's for equal types, breaking the equals/hashCode contract; both formulas replaced by the JDK's

Unicode escapes above U+FFFF returned Character.toChars(cp)[0], silently a lone high surrogate; fix replaces that misuse with a BMP check that throws plus a char cast, so the old expression does not survive
ImmutableTimeZone wrapper never overrode equals and hashCode, so wrappers of equal zones compared by identity; both methods added, delegating to the wrapped zone
lexer never reset previous after an optional bracket, quote or literal character, so same-letter fields separated by them merged into one token; four missing previous = null resets added
input made of a lone CSV quote character passed the starts-and-ends-with-quote test, then threw in subSequence(1, 0); existing condition gained input.length() < 2
numeric entities beyond U+10FFFF reached Character.toChars, which throws IllegalArgumentException, instead of being left untranslated; missing code-point range guard returning 0 added
parse(Path) and parse(URL) opened a stream that leaked when parser construction threw, since the caller never got a parser to close; new helper closes it on failure: resource lifecycle

for-loop update advanced pos after every case, including after getQuotedString had already moved past the closing quote, skipping the next character such as '}'; advancing rewritten per case, excluding the quote case
arrayMemberHash had no branch for annotation arrays, hashing them with Arrays.hashCode instead of AnnotationUtils.hashCode, inconsistent with arrayMemberEquals; branch and helper added

owner types ignored by containsTypeVariables and unrollVariables (dominant), fixed by rewriting the recursion around identity sets; also bundled: a never-cleared visited set left repeated variables unresolved, and self-referential Types recursed endlessly
createBigInteger accepted a second sign after the leading one (e.g. --1), which new BigInteger consumed, silently flipping the sign; missing check throwing NumberFormatException added

an unmatched quote threw IllegalArgumentException where the parent MessageFormat treats it as closed at the end of the pattern; the throw is replaced by returning the rest, removing the over-strict behaviour

end-bound check rejected letters-and-digits ranges reaching digits but not letters, as it tested any category unreachable instead of all (wrong connective, dominant); also bundled: a missing empty-range check after clamping above 'z'

stripAccents returned the NFKD-decomposed text after removing combining marks, leaving unaccented characters such as Hangul decomposed; return now recomposes with NFC, an unconditional transform, so Normalizer misuse rather than addition
startPos + width overflowed int when width is Integer.MAX_VALUE, giving a negative limit and wrap index; the sum is now computed as a long, a wrong-type value substituted in three expressions

equalsIgnoreCase compared only upper-cased chars, so pairs equal only after String.equalsIgnoreCase's second lower-case step were reported unequal; existing condition gained the toLowerCase comparison
read() added getEncodedCharLength(EOF) to bytesRead at end of stream, corrupting the byte count; existing encoder != null condition gained && current != EOF
a zero-width wrap-pattern match at the line start advanced offset by matcher.end() = 0, looping forever; matcher.end() survives inside a new ternary that advances by 1 for empty matches

indexOf with tolerance never matched NaN since NaN-based min/max fail every comparison; NaN guard and helper added, the other overload's existing NaN test moved behind the same guard unchanged in behaviour
maxRows was checked against the parser's running recordNumber, which can differ from the rows this iterator returned, cutting output early; a dedicated iterator counter replaces the wrong variable
